endangerment.comment: Argentine Sign Language (aed-aed) = 5 (Developing). Recognized language (2023, Ley 27710).

classification.sub: Derives from deaf schools founded around 1900 either influenced by or derived from Italian Sign Language (**hh:styp:Manrique:Argentine-Sign**:27-28, **hh:s:MassoneMartinez:Argentine-Sign**:73-75). Since there is no assertion that it does derive from an Italian Sign Language of the early 1900s it is a presumed isolate. A systematic lexical investigation remains to be done.
